items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: I was in Little Rock and working with Ethel May's band, a woman band, you know.

ctx.x: And they says all of them washed him away and says Prez washed everybody away with "Ideas" and things.

So Smack -- we called Fletcher "Smack" -- Smack chose Lester over Ben or Herschel and so when Basie, maybe about a couple of weeks later, Basie brings the Bennie Moten band to Little Rock. So I was in Little Rock and working with Ethel May's band, a woman band, you know. So --
